presentation.description: The expression-development workflow performed: agents arrive at the goal, carry the work from A to B, invoke their skills, hand results between them, face review and return — in the nocturne field.

scene.character: An agent enters the field and takes up the work: its character arrives beside the goal.
scene.name: Arrival

scene.character: Work moves from A to B: the object travels between stations while its bearer keeps pace.
scene.name: Work passage

scene.character: A skill flares through the bearer while the passage continues.
scene.name: Skill invocation

scene.character: A sender passes an artifact to a recipient with a caption: the object crosses between them.
scene.name: Handoff

scene.character: The work is held up to its checks: a resonant plate rings under the artifact; the outcome settles its colour.
scene.name: Review

scene.character: The cast gathers at the goal; the goal opens and the result is written beneath it.
scene.name: Completion

scene.character: The same cast returns to the work: the passage runs back through the station it left.
scene.name: Continuation

scene.character: One agent explains: it speaks beside the subject while the subject unfolds its layers and the words build up.
scene.name: Explanation
